recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot portrait of a blonde woman sitting on a slatted wooden bench in a soft-focus outdoor setting. She wears a white flowing dress and brown leather boots, with a central typographic overlay featuring elegant script and a secondary serif line.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against horizontal wooden slats
Warm skin tones contrasting with cool green background
Text centered horizontally across the subject's lap
Soft, diffused sunlight creating a halo effect on hair

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the central typographic block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's eyes down to the central text, then following the horizontal lines of the bench slats.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Soft-focus green area at the top and bottom corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and wood tones (background and skin)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High key with soft saturation; low contrast in the background to emphasize the subject.

letterConstructionRules: Script features long, flowing swashes extending horizontally
High contrast between thick and thin strokes in the script
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended horizontal flourishes on the first and last letters of the primary name
Tightly tracked lowercase serif for the subtitle
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a fluid, expressive script and a rigid, geometric serif.
graphicDevices: Subtle drop shadow for legibility against white fabric

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast calligraphic feel and swash potential.
Provides a classic, stable serif for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution photograph of a blonde woman with wavy hair sitting on a light-colored wooden slatted bench. She is wearing a white ethereal dress and brown leather cowboy boots. The background is a soft-focus green lawn. Lighting should be warm and diffused.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a centered typographic block. The top line should be a large, elegant dark brown script with long horizontal flourishes. The second line should be a smaller, spaced-out serif in a medium brown tone, positioned directly underneath the script.

verificationChecks: Text is legible against the white dress
Bench slats are horizontal and parallel
Lighting creates a soft glow on the subject's hair

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Any branded logos on the boots

mustAchieve: Tactile texture in the wood and fabric

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white dress doesn't blow out highlights
Verify the script flourishes don't obscure the face
Confirm the background blur is smooth and consistent
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject [Person] + Setting [Slatted Wood] + Lighting [Soft/Warm] + Typography [Script/Serif Overlay]
